name: Amba Enterprises Limited
about: Amba Enterprises Limited operates as a power engineering solutions company in India. It engages in the manufacturing and selling of transformer cores and laminations, and stampings for rotating machines. The company also provides CRNGO/CRNO lamination strips; transformer lamination; generator and alternator stampings; transformer lamination sheets, and coils; motor and pump stampings; slit and full coil; die-cast rotor; inserted shaft with rotor; and trading of electrical steel and related raw materials. Amba Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
